prompt: Write an email as the teaching assistant of the "Introduction to Computer Science" course, and tell the class that we will not be meeting this week.
response_text:
Subject: No Class This Week – Introduction to Computer Science

Dear Students,

I hope this email finds you well. I am writing to let you know that our Introduction to Computer Science class will **not** be meeting this week. This applies to all scheduled sessions, including lectures and any associated lab or discussion sections.

Please use this time to review the course materials covered so far, work on any outstanding assignments, and prepare for upcoming topics. All previously assigned deadlines remain unchanged unless you hear otherwise from the professor or myself.

If you have any questions or concerns in the meantime, please don't hesitate to reach out to me via email, and I will do my best to respond in a timely manner. Additionally, be sure to check the course page on our learning management system for any updates or announcements.

We look forward to seeing you back in class next week. Enjoy the extra time, and please stay on top of your coursework!

Best regards,

[Your Name]
Teaching Assistant – Introduction to Computer Science
[Your Email Address]
[Office Hours & Location, if applicable]
